title: Event record
description: One adverse event of one patient. The engine records events of grade 3 to 5 and interstitial lung disease of any grade.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: CTCAE grade. Grade 5 is death from the event.

onset_day.title: Day of onset
onset_day.description: Day on which the event actually started.

day.title: Day of recognition
day.description: Day on which the event was recognised by the care team. Later than onset_day if recognition was delayed.

action.title: Action
action.description: Change of the therapy in response to the event.
